caption: No order book. The price is just whatever ratio keeps the product constant.

code:
Trader sends 10 ETH in.
New x = 100 + 10 = 110 ETH
New y = k / new x = 20,000,000 / 110 = 181,818.18 USDC

USDC out = 200,000 - 181,818.18 = 18,181.82 USDC
Effective price: 1,818.18 USDC per ETH (vs. 2,000 spot)
caption: That gap is price impact — a consequence of the formula, not a fee on top.
